## The Papers

```{r}
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

newspaper <- read_sheet_safe(NEWSPAPER_SHEET_URL)

if (nrow(newspaper) > 0 && "Link" %in% names(newspaper)) {
  newspaper <- newspaper |>
    filter(!is.na(Link) & Link != "") |>
    mutate(Link = sprintf("[%s](%s)", "Click here for link", Link))
}

if (nrow(newspaper) > 0 && "Link" %in% names(newspaper)) {
  newspaper |>
    gt() |>
    fmt_markdown(columns = Link) |>
    cols_label(Edition = "Edition", Date = "Date", Link = "View") |>
    opt_interactive(use_sorting = TRUE, use_search = TRUE,
                    use_filters = FALSE, use_resizers = TRUE) |>
    opt_row_striping()
} else {
  cat("Class newspaper not available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# The outlet directory as tiles. A tile links to the outlet's article page
# when a Link is set; until then it stands as a nameplate. Logos land in
# files/images/logos/<outlet_slug>.png and appear automatically.
news <- tryCatch(read.csv(JOURNALIST_CSV), error = function(e) data.frame())

if (nrow(news) > 0) {
  tiles <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(news)), function(i) {
    outlet <- news$Newspaper[i]
    slug   <- tolower(gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(outlet)))
    logo   <- sprintf("files/images/logos/%s.png", slug)

    face <- if (file.exists(logo)) {
      sprintf('<span class="tile-plate"><img src="%s" alt="%s"></span>', logo, outlet)
    } else {
      # Monogram from the outlet's initials
      initials <- paste(substr(strsplit(outlet, "\\s+")[[1]], 1, 1), collapse = "")
      sprintf('<span class="tile-mono">%s</span>', toupper(substr(initials, 1, 3)))
    }

    link <- news$Link[i]
    inner <- sprintf('%s<span class="tile-name">%s</span>', face, outlet)
    if (!is.na(link) && link != "") {
      sprintf('<a class="tile" href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', link, inner)
    } else {
      sprintf('<div class="tile" title="Articles coming soon">%s</div>', inner)
    }
  }, character(1))

  cat('<div class="tile-grid">', paste(tiles, collapse = "\n"), '</div>')
} else {
  cat("Newspaper list not available yet.\n")
}
```
